description_en: Deletes a metric import task for Alibaba Cloud services or a metric for the logs that are imported from Log Service
description_zh: 调用DeleteHybridMonitorTask接口删除阿里云产品的数据接入任务或SLS日志的监控项
name: DeleteHybridMonitorTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the metric import task.

For information about how to obtain the ID of a metric import task, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428624.html.

This parameter is required only if you call this operation to delete metrics for the logs that are imported from Log Service. In this case, the `TaskType` parameter is set to `aliyun_sls`
parameters.help_zh:
监控任务ID。

关于如何获取监控任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/428624.html。

当您删除SLS日志的监控项（即`TaskType`为`aliyun_sls`）时，必须设置该参数
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the namespace.

The name can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

This parameter is required only if you call this operation to delete metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services. In this case, the `TaskType` parameter is set to `aliyun_fc`
parameters.help_zh:
指标仓库名称。

格式：由大写字母、小写字母、数字和短划线（-）组成。

当您删除阿里云产品的数据接入任务（即`TaskType`为`aliyun_fc`）时，必须设置该参数
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account.

This parameter is required only if you use a management account to call this operation to query metric import tasks that belong to a member in a resource directory. In this case, the `TaskType` parameter is set to `aliyun_fc`
parameters.help_zh:
成员ID。

仅当您通过管理账号调用本接口删除成员的阿里云数据接入任务（即`TaskType`为`aliyun_fc`）时，需要设置该参数
parameters.name: target_user_id

Code.description_en:
The status code.

The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。
false：失败
